verdict.rationale: Zep builds a Context Graph of entities/relations from chat, JSON, docs and business data, supports custom entity/edge types, and its search combines semantic + BM25 over edges/nodes/episodes to answer entity-centric and multi-hop questions; the underlying Graphiti temporal knowledge graph explicitly tracks facts, provenance, and relationships over time. Missing for 10: no independent third-party benchmark demonstrating multi-hop QA accuracy beyond vendor docs/community praise.
